propositions: The single-pass demo engine and its associated parity harness, prompt, eval spec, and eval-solver branch must be fully removed while preserving byte-unchanged four-phase workflows.
Finished-cutover scaffolding including shadow comparators, spot-eval harness, and private re-exports must be deleted with all importers migrated.
Severity must no longer drive gate policy; REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH must be removed with prefetch always enabled; legacy overlay activate: form must warn once per overlay via deprecation registry.
Five dead attestation helpers must be removed, the duplicated unresolvable-ref message must be single-sourced, and plan-review status must emit only schema-declared values.
All client-facing changes require release-notes entries.
